title: What I’ve learned: B2, the final block
pt: Foco da aula: revisão final do B2: o que você já sabe fazer

solo90.name: Pausa
solo90.desc: 5 minutos: câmera e microfone desligados. O professor anota 3 erros reais ouvidos até aqui para a correção final.

group90.name: Pausa
group90.desc: 5 minutos: câmera e microfone desligados. O professor anota 3 erros reais ouvidos até aqui para a correção final.

lines.en: Clara, today is our last class of the B2 course. Do you remember how nervous you were when we started?
lines.pt: Clara, hoje é a nossa última aula do curso B2. Você lembra como estava nervosa quando começamos?

lines.en: I do. I had been studying English for years, but I had never spoken to anyone for more than two minutes.
lines.pt: Lembro. Eu estudava inglês havia anos, mas nunca tinha falado com ninguém por mais de dois minutos.

lines.en: And now you have been giving presentations for months. Last week the director said she had been impressed by your talk.
lines.pt: E agora você faz apresentações há meses. Semana passada a diretora disse que tinha ficado impressionada com a sua palestra.

lines.en: Really? I was told that I spoke too fast, but I have been trying to slow down, and that has helped.
lines.pt: Sério? Disseram-me que eu falava rápido demais, mas tenho tentado desacelerar, e isso ajudou.

lines.en: It shows. If you had not practised every day, you would not have improved so quickly. Do you wish you had started sooner?
lines.pt: Dá para ver. Se você não tivesse praticado todo dia, não teria melhorado tão rápido. Você gostaria de ter começado antes?

lines.en: Sometimes, yes. I wish I had begun at school. But I am used to learning slowly now, and I do not mind it.
lines.pt: Às vezes, sim. Queria ter começado na escola. Mas agora estou acostumada a aprender devagar, e não me importo.

lines.en: You have had your writing corrected every week. By next year you will have finished your course at university.
lines.pt: Você mandou corrigir seus textos toda semana. Até o ano que vem terá terminado seu curso na universidade.

lines.en: I hope so. My cousin, whose English is perfect, says I should join a debate club so that I keep improving.
lines.pt: Espero que sim. Minha prima, cujo inglês é perfeito, diz que devo entrar num clube de debate para continuar melhorando.

lines.en: Excellent advice. Provided that you keep reading and listening every week, you will not lose what you have learned.
lines.pt: Ótimo conselho. Desde que você continue lendo e ouvindo toda semana, não perderá o que aprendeu.

lines.en: I will. Although I would rather study with friends than alone, because I find the motivation lasts much longer that way.
lines.pt: Vou continuar. Embora eu prefira estudar com amigos a estudar sozinha, porque acho que a motivação dura muito mais assim.

lines.en: Then form a group. Thank you for your hard work, Clara. I am sure you will go far, and I will be proud of you.
lines.pt: Então forme um grupo. Obrigada pelo seu esforço, Clara. Tenho certeza de que você vai longe, e vou me orgulhar de você.

facts.big: past perfect · wish · reported speech · future perfect
facts.label: Revisão B2
facts.sub: I had never spoken. I wish I had begun sooner. By next year I will have finished.

facts.label: mais-que-perfeito
facts.sub: Had + particípio: I had never spoken for two minutes. She said she had been impressed. Fala de uma ação anterior a outro ponto do passado.

facts.label: queria ter
facts.sub: Wish + had + particípio: I wish I had started sooner. Mostra arrependimento do passado. Não diga I wish I would have.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: I wish I had started sooner talks about a past regret.
We say I wish I would have started sooner.
items.why: We say I wish I had started sooner.

items.s: Had been studying shows an action before another past action.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: I wish I had started sooner talks about a past regret. → Verdadeiro (Wish + past perfect.)
We say I wish I would have started sooner. → Falso (We say I wish I had started sooner.)
Had been studying shows an action before another past action. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 2/2

items.s: By next year I will have finished is future perfect.

pages.instruction: Mais uma rodada: decida e explique.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.

extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Provided that means because of. → Falso (It means only if.)
By next year I will have finished is future perfect. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: What I have learned: B2 · 1/3
paragraphs: It is the last class in Seattle. Rain falls on the windows. Tess stands by the board. Clara sits in her usual place. A whole year has passed. Today they look back.

“Clara, today is our last class of the B2 course. Do you remember how nervous you were when we started?” says Tess. “I do. I had been studying English for years, but I had never spoken to anyone for more than two minutes.” says Clara. “And now you have been giving presentations for months. Last week the director said she had been impressed by your talk.” says Tess.
